title: Cam360
description: Cam360 is a Minecraft mod based on Fabric to take 360° screenshots in Minecraft.
body:
Cam360 is a Fabric Mod that let's you take 360 images in Minecraft when you press a key, the mod will automatically tilt to all the different angles and take a screenshot.

This is a client side mod, and the Fabric API is highly encouraged in order to use it. You must also have at least Java 25 installed.
